principles: Stable IDs are never derived solely from display names.
Authority-specific identifiers are retained alongside Sukuu IDs.
Geography stores both administrative IDs and human-readable names.
Operational geographies such as police regions remain separate dimensions.
Every externally sourced factual field must be traceable to at least one provenance event.
Expiry/deadline data is time-sensitive and must not be silently promoted to current status after its last verification date.

core_fields.meaning: Lifecycle state of the entity/record, not source trust
Source, observation date, verification state and method
